_note: Paper: HippMetric (arXiv 2512.19214). The gym scores two substitutes for the ADNI/GHABS cohorts (no clinical data or manual annotations are redistributable): a procedural segmentation cohort with known skeletal geometry, and a real-anatomy longitudinal cohort whose baselines are real manual hippocampus labels (MSD Task04) and whose follow-ups carry hidden, known erosion of the head region, smooth warps and new poses, mirroring the paper's simulated-atrophy study. Entries under method keys without a leading underscore are paper numbers on a definition comparable to the gym's metric; entries whose definition or scale differs are kept under '_paper_*' keys and in '_paper_reported' for reference only and are not targets.

_paper_reported.thickness_accuracy: Subfield mean thickness error vs manual measurement (10 ADNI subjects): largest single-skeleton error tail 0.5 mm, CA3/CA4/subiculum < 0.25 mm, composite subfields <= 0.20 mm (Section 5.1).
_paper_reported.surface_Q_definition_note: The paper's Q is sqrt(sum of squared paired distances)/n, which shrinks with vertex count; the gym's surface_Q_mm is an RMS of unpaired bidirectional distances, so Q values are not comparable.

subfield_thickness_accuracy.description: Local thickness of the hippocampal sheet at every template skeletal point, recomputed from the submitted skeletal points and superior/inferior spoke endpoints. Procedural cohort: point-wise and subfield thickness against known ground truth on baseline (including disease-thinned subjects) and atrophied follow-up scans, and the accuracy of measured longitudinal thinning. Real-anatomy cohort (held-out MSD Task04 hippocampi with hidden, known head atrophy, warps and poses on follow-ups): accuracy of the measured thickness change of each spoke. Validity on both cohorts guards against thickness obtained from geometry that does not reach the true boundary or folds over.

thickness_mae_mm.description: Mean absolute error of point-wise thickness (sum of superior and inferior spoke lengths) over all scans and skeletal points.

thickness_p95_abs_error_mm.description: 95th percentile of the point-wise absolute thickness error, penalising localised failures hidden by the mean.

subfield_mean_thickness_error_mm.description: Absolute difference between predicted and true mean thickness within each subfield (the paper's D statistic), averaged over subfields and scans.

longitudinal_thickness_change_error_mm.description: Mean absolute error of the measured thickness change (follow-up minus the same subject's baseline) at skeletal points inside the eroded region. Doing worse than predicting no change fails the run.

valid_spoke_fraction.description: Fraction of spokes whose endpoint lies within 1 mm of the true boundary and whose endpoint grid preserves the skeletal ordering (no local fold-over). Computed by the evaluator from geometry; below 0.5 the run is failed.

real_thickness_change_error_mm.description: Mean absolute error of the measured follow-up-minus-baseline thickness of each spoke against the true change of the same spoke, inside the atrophic region. Doing no better than reporting no change fails the run.

real_valid_spoke_fraction.description: Fraction of real-anatomy spokes whose endpoint lies within 1 mm of the true boundary and whose endpoint grid preserves the skeletal ordering. Below 0.5 the run fails.

correspondence_stability.description: Point-wise anatomical correspondence. Procedural cohort: distance between each submitted spoke endpoint and the true boundary point carrying the same template coordinate, on baseline scans (cross-sectional) and inside the eroded anterior region on follow-up scans (longitudinal). Real-anatomy cohort: each submitted baseline endpoint is followed through the hidden, known follow-up change (head erosion along the true normals, smooth warp, new pose); the error is the distance between the submitted follow-up endpoint and the true follow-up position of the same anatomical point, inside the atrophic region and in the stable region.

cross_sectional_correspondence_error_mm.description: Mean correspondence error over all 1,098 superior/inferior boundary points of every baseline scan.

cross_sectional_p95_correspondence_error.description: 95th percentile of the cross-sectional correspondence error.

longitudinal_correspondence_error_mm.description: Mean correspondence error over boundary points inside the subject's atrophic region on follow-up scans.

longitudinal_p95_correspondence_error_mm.description: 95th percentile of the longitudinal correspondence error.

real_longitudinal_correspondence_error_m.description: Mean distance between each submitted follow-up endpoint and the true follow-up position of the anatomical point its baseline endpoint marked, over endpoints inside the atrophic region (erosion >= 30% of its peak).

real_longitudinal_p95_correspondence_err.description: 95th percentile of the atrophic-region longitudinal correspondence error.

real_stable_correspondence_error_mm.description: The same correspondence error over endpoints outside the atrophic region (erosion < 5% of its peak), where only the warp and pose act: correspondence must not drift where no tissue is lost.

correspondence_stability._note: The paper's longitudinal numbers (1.68 mm HippMetric; 3.56 SPHARM-PDM, 4.65 ds-rep, 10.57 cm-rep) come from its simulated-atrophy study on 15 real ADNI baselines with manual landmarks; they are listed on longitudinal_correspondence_error_mm. The real-anatomy metrics measure the same kind of study against exact known positions (no manual-landmark noise) with smooth warps added, so the paper values are not targets for them.

surface_robustness.description: Fidelity of the boundary implied by the submitted s-rep (spoke endpoints, bilinearly densified on the template grid) to the true clean boundary: on baseline and atrophied procedural scans (Q, HD, p95), and on every real-anatomy scan (Q).

surface_Q_mm.description: Root-mean-square of unpaired bidirectional nearest distances between the implied and true boundary, averaged over scans.

surface_HD_mm.description: Hausdorff distance max(h(A,B), h(B,A)) between implied and true boundary, averaged over scans.

surface_p95_mm.description: 95th percentile of the bidirectional nearest distances, a tail measure less brittle than the maximum.

real_surface_Q_mm.description: Root-mean-square of the bidirectional nearest distances between the implied boundary (endpoints densified on the template grid) and the true noise-free boundary, averaged over all real-anatomy scans.
